reason: I already buy energy cans and pre-workout in bulk from GymBeam for way less, and 55 crowns for one can with only 80 mg of caffeine is half the kick of a Monster at a higher price. I might glance at it at the bistro, but I wouldn't pay that before training.
objection: The label is all English and I can't tell if it's even a Czech product, and 55 CZK for 80 mg of caffeine doesn't feel worth it next to what I already drink.
would_change_my_mind: A multipack on Vilgain or GymBeam that brings it down to around 35 CZK a can, with a Czech label so I know who makes it.
